messages:
Rhea: Quick standup  we need final hero lines + short proof bullets for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private, an inbound form slug list, and a tweet + linkedin announcement. Can we ship this afternoon?
Max: Ill do Hosted hero variants. Aim for three tight options: performance, dev velocity, and cost-efficiency. Will include one-line sample latency proof.
Anu: Ill author Dedicated and Private micro-bullets + a tiny 'sample results' benchmark blurb for Dedicated. Bullets must be 3-6 words.
Victor: Ill build the RSVP form and routing rules in Growth. Prefer snake_case slugs: deployment_choice, lead_purpose, company_size. Will you want demo alerts?
Rhea: Routing priority: demo -> sales-demo queue + immediate slack ping; enterprise -> sales-enterprise + ops tag; technical -> devx queue (daily digest); webinar RSVPs -> growth automation. If deployment_choice == private and lead_purpose in (demo, enterprise) -> mark priority_private.
Max: Hosted drafts: 1) "Hosted inference for product teams." proof: "p50 ~100ms (short Q&A, sample)." 2) "Fast API, predictable cost." 3) "Start with free credits." CTAs: "Get started (free credits)", "View docs".
Anu: Dedicated bullets: "Reserved GPU pools", "Throughput SLAs", "Burst capacity". Benchmark blurb: "Sample results: ~160 QPS, p95 220ms on common configs (see benchmarks)." Private bullets: "VPC & on-prem", "KMS/HSM support", "Audit logs & SOC2-ready".
Victor: Routing pseudo: if lead_purpose == "demo" -> sales-demo + slack:#sales-notifs immediate; elif lead_purpose == "enterprise" -> sales-enterprise + add_tag:enterprise_ops; elif lead_purpose == "technical" -> devx-queue (batch daily); elif lead_purpose == "webinar" -> growth-rsvp-automation. If deployment_choice == "private" and lead_purpose in ["demo","enterprise"]: add_tag:priority_private.
integrations-bot: Routing rules deployed to staging (job 7321) :white_check_mark:
Rhea: Social copy: Tweet: "Ship LLM features faster with hosted inference + predictable economics. RSVP for our webinar: <link>?utm_source=launch_twitter" LinkedIn: longer note + bullets on what we'll demo. Add utm table: twitter/linkedin/email.
Max: One more nuance: include a tiny example prompt under Hosted like "Answer: What's the refund policy? -> response in ~100ms p50 (sample)" to make latency claim concrete.
Anu: Marking Dedicated benchmark as "sample results" so not a guarantee. Also adding 2-line FAQ for Dedicated scaling.
Victor: Ill attach the webhook payload example and stage a test. Need final field slugs by 3pm.
Rhea: Action items: Max finalize Hosted copy + CTAs (due 2:30pm), Anu finalize Dedicated/Private bullets + benchmark snippet (due 2:30pm), Victor post webhook spec + staging test (due 4pm), Ill collect assets and push to /marketing-assets and tag #design (due 5pm). React with :white_check_mark: when done.
